title: Product diagram of fraction numerators
statement: Let $C,D$ be categories, $W,W^{\prime}$ morphism properties on $C,D$, $F:C\to D$ a functor, $K\in C$ and $M\in D$. Let $J$ be the category of arrows $s:K\to I$ in $W$, with arbitrary commuting triangles, and let $T$ be the category of arrows $t:P\to M$ in $W^{\prime}$ with arbitrary commuting triangles. The numerator diagram $H:J\times T^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{Type}$ assigns $\operatorname{Hom}_D(P,F(I))$ to $(s,t)$. For $a:I\to I^{\prime}$ and $b:P^{\prime}\to P$ satisfying $s a=s^{\prime}$ and $b t=t^{\prime}$ in diagrammatic composition, its transition sends $f$ to $b f F(a)$.
